title: Compare two lists or two command outputs and see what differs
summary: Show the differences between two files, or between the output of two commands, without making temporary copies. Lines starting with < are only in the first input, lines starting with > only in the second.

aliases.text: what is different between two files

steps.explain: <( ) runs a command and gives diff a file-like name with its output, so no temporary file is needed. sort puts both lists in the same order first, so only real differences show. diff exits with status 1 when they differ, which is not an error.
steps.expect: Lines starting with < exist only in FILE_A and lines starting with > only in FILE_B. No output means the two lists are the same.

steps.explain: Compare what two commands print, for example the file names in two folders.
steps.expect: The same < and > markers, here showing names that exist in only one folder.
